text:
Bright hello cargo crew,
The kennel attendant sent an update on spare blankets

Thanks for keeping the animal area steady and quiet while we sort the last round of checks. I want to flag a few safety points in a warm, practical way so the handoff stays smooth for everyone involved. Please keep crates fully latched, confirm water cups are seated before loading, and watch for any bedding that shifts after ramp movement. If a traveler has a nervous pet, a calm voice and slow hand movements still make a big difference. The senior coordinator is already tracking the day’s service decisions, so there is no need to rush the process.

For the rabbit file in particular, <<FACT F082>> I am asking everyone to treat that note as a simple gate check and not as a cue to improvise. If the papers look incomplete or a label seems off, please pause the transfer and alert the desk right away. That is the safest path for the animal, the cabin team, and the ramp crew. We want each journey to feel orderly, and we want the people handling the carriers to feel supported while they do it.

Also, if Ruby or any other pet shows signs of stress, please let the companion animal travel desk know before departure so we can adjust the plan with care. A small delay is always better than a shaky handoff. Thanks for the steady work, the kind tone, and the attention you give to every crate that passes through Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
